text: ATA Airline is one of the companies of the Daric Investment Group, which profiles the airline on its own website. Named press reported ATA's owner as Mohammad Reza Zonouzi-Motlaq, the group's founder and owner.
short: ATA Airlines is a Daric Investment Group company; press names its owner as Mohammad Reza Zonouzi-Motlaq.
